preparations.title: Breakfast Preserves
preparations.description: P01–P03 · Seville marmalade, strawberry and vanilla confiture, and raspberry confiture. Opening breakfast preserves; the marmalade comes from the January reserve.

preparations.title: Summer Fruit Preserves
preparations.description: P04–P06 · Apricot and vanilla, bourbon and black cherry, and blackcurrant preserves. Hatfield Original is credited on the cherry label.

preparations.title: Curd & Compote
preparations.description: P07–P08 · Lemon and verbena curd and peach and vanilla compote. Fresh chilled preparations for breakfast and pastry, labelled Keep Refrigerated.

preparations.title: Table Condiments
preparations.description: P09–P10 · Moutarde de la maison and tomato ketchup with red-wine vinegar. A mustard jar and practical sauce bottle for everyday table service.

preparations.title: Cornichons, Shallots & Red Onions
preparations.description: P11, P12, P15 · Cornichons with tarragon, shallots in herb vinegar and quick-pickled red onions. The onion preparation remains chilled.

preparations.title: Savoury Pantry
preparations.description: P13–P14, P16–P17 · Onion confit, tomato and Espelette confit, beetroot with orange and coriander, and courgette with mustard seed. Stored according to each preparation; the beetroot is chilled.

preparations.title: Granola, Crackers & Savoury Sablés
preparations.description: P18–P20 · Oat, almond and seed granola, seeded rye crackers, and Parmesan and black-pepper sablés. Dry storage jars sized for their contents.

preparations.title: Biscuits & Bar Snacks
preparations.description: P21–P24 · Butter shortbread, dark-chocolate and sea-salt sablés, rosemary and smoked-salt almonds, and lime-leaf and chilli cashews. Regular baking and bar-snack batches.

preparations.title: Cocktail Cherries, Syrup & Cordials
preparations.description: P25–P28 · Cocktail cherries, vanilla syrup, ginger and lemongrass cordial, and passion-fruit and lime cordial. House bar preparations; both cordials are kept refrigerated.

preparations.title: House Ice Creams
preparations.description: P29–P30 · Vanilla-bean and dark-chocolate ice creams in labelled freezer tubs. Shown open for the photograph; stored covered and frozen.

preparations.title: Rhubarb & Orange Cordial
preparations.description: Spring seasonal cordial; recipe and packaging reference.

preparations.title: Blackberry & Apple Cordial
preparations.description: Autumn seasonal cordial; recipe and packaging reference.
